tei:div.tei:p: rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa la/ sems bskyed sdom chog brgyud 'debs/ rang gi snying ga'i= 'di dang 'gugs pa la/ dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i= kha sgyur/ skyabs sems/ yan brgyad/ lha skyed/ 'bar ba'i klongaḥ 'phros/ gzhung las/ 'og min= gsalaḥ bar/ bsnyen dmigs/ thugs kar= tshogasaḥ oṃ hu lu hu lu bhu phaṭaḥ e a rali hūm̐ hrīḥdzaḥ bsdu ldang*/ cha gsum/ sa chog/ rgyal tho/ sri mnan/ sgo byang*/ ma ṭam/ chag chag hu lu= bsnyen/ lha tshom dbus/ de rgyab bcu drug de rgyab so gnyis/ de rgyab brgyad/ sgo bzhi/ mchod rlabs/ lha bskyed gong ltar/ dbang bskur la/ pra te= snga ma/ spyan 'dren/ hūṃḥ thugs rje= bstod pa/ mi sdug= tshig bzhi/ be ḍūr sngon po= bstodaḥ bsnyen pa/ rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsolaḥ khyed rnams mchod dang sems can donaḥ nangs par dkyil 'khor bri 'tshal bsaḥ thugs kyis dgongs te gnang bar mdzod/ badzra tiṣṭha lhanaḥ bum sta/ slob ma sta gon/ thig tshon bcas/ ༈ rgyan 'god nyin/ las byang thab lugs gong ltar/ bzlas pa/ rab gnas bsnyen pa/ bdag 'jug rab gnas cha tshang la/ rgyan bkod/ gsol ka tshogs bskang bcas/ ༈ dngos gzhi nyin bdun la/ sngon 'gro ngag 'don/ sems bskyed sdom 70) chog las byang gong ltar/ phyi chog mnyam 'don/ bum sgrub/ mchod phreng*/ gsol ka na rag skong bshags/ tshogs/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ bdag 'jug drang lhag gsol ka bskyang*/ bskul/ chad brtan/ bro/ mchod bstod bshags rten bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis bskrad byin bcas/ ༈ nyin brgyad par/ las byang*/ gsol ka tshogs/ bskul pa/ dngos grub/ sham sbyar bsnyen/ nyulle bskrad/ byin 'bebs/ dngos grub blang*/ dbang chen/ ༈ sbyin sreg la/ tshig bdun/ 'dzam gling= rdo dril byin rlabs/ mchod rlabs zhi rol/ sman gtor rakta'i sngags/ sreg rdzas byin rlabs/ me thab byin rlabs/ agne ye dzwa= rol/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rol/ thabs kyi= hūṃḥ ye shes= bum gdangs/ rol/

oṃ agne ye= gnyis/ me lha'i= rtsa gdangs/ shabda= rol/ me lha= agna ye= bdun/ oṃ na ma= rol/ de 'dra gsum/ oṃ pra ti= khams gsum= rol/ oṃ agne ye= bdun/ khams gsum= rol/ oṃ na ma= khams gsum= rol/ de 'dra brgyad/ hūm̐ḥ me lha'i= nyis btegs/ phyed phyag na moḥrig pa'i= sogs nas/ bsnol= ma'i stengaḥ spyan 'dren gdangs chen/ hūm̐ḥ thugs rje lcags kyus= rol ring*/ rtsa sngags tshar grangs kyis tshom bu thab tu dor/ rta mgrin gyi/ dpal chen rta mchog rol pa= sogs/ lnga btegs kyis/ chen por gsalaḥ bar/ 71) hūm̐ḥ bla med= nas/ shabda= rol/ dkyil 'khor gyi= rtsa sngags bdun/ a tri dang*/ ye shes me dang= rol/ de 'dra gsum/ rtsa sngags bcu/ a tri= ye shes= rol/ de 'dra brgya/ dgang blugs nyer gcig rol gsum/ lha tshogs= de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ oṃ badzra wast+ra ye swa hāḥ rol/ badzra taṃ bu= rol/ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i pa'i nas dbang du gyur/ rtsa sngags la sham sbyar nyer gcig arghaṃ= rol/ mi sdug= tshig bzhi/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dngaḥ gtso bo nus pa ma mchis pasaḥ 'dir ni bgyi ba gang nongs paḥ de kun mgon pos bzod par gsolaḥ yig brgya/ lha tshogs rnams sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor la gshegs par gyur/ rol rigs/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang nyid la thim par gyur/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la= oṃ na maḥs manta buddha naṃ bi ma le agna ye swa hāḥ khams gsum skye rgu'i dpal 'byor thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ rol/ de 'dra bcu/ tam bu= rol/ wast+ra= rol/ shabda= rol/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lhaḥ drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdagaḥ shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas laḥ mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshalaḥ na maḥs manta= mchod sbyin gtor ma= rnal 'byor 72) rol/ ma rnyed= yig brgya/ badzra= rnam par gyur/ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dgongs su gsolaḥ phun sum tshogs pa= khrom dbang*/ drang lhag/ gsol bskyang*/

bskul chad brtan bro/ mchod bstod bshags pa/ oṃ/ khyed kyi= bsdu ldang*/ rgyal tho/ sgo byang*/ khro bcu bsdu/ mar me'i smon lam/ las byang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis/ bla ma yi dam= phun sum tshogs pa= bkra shis dga' bskor bcas so// dge'o//
